name: Desktop Soundbeam
description: Accessible computer-based Soundbeam system with a dedicated interface, sensors and Windows software.

documentation.title: Desktop Soundbeam official manuals and support

notice: Install the matching Desktop Soundbeam software and interface driver, then configure sensor input, MIDI routing and sound destinations in that software. The manufacturer specifies 32-bit Windows XP, Vista or Windows 7 and states development ended in spring 2012. Do not assume compatibility with modern Windows or a class-compliant USB MIDI connection. Notes, channels and expression depend on the selected setup; this profile supplies setup guidance rather than a fixed note or CC map. Select this profile manually: port names have not been verified. The panel is an original conceptual schematic, not a scaled drawing of the physical controls.
